exercises/weekly-exercises.title: Weekly Exercises: Physical AI & Humanoid Robotics
exercises/weekly-exercises.description: This comprehensive exercise collection covers all 13 weeks of the Physical AI & Humanoid Robotics course. Each week's exercises build upon the previous concepts and lead to the final capstone project.

intro.title: Physical AI & Humanoid Robotics
intro.description: Welcome to Physical AI & Humanoid Robotics

intro/index.title: Introduction to Physical AI & Humanoid Robotics
intro/index.description: Welcome to "Physical AI & Humanoid Robotics: Embodied Intelligence in the Real World". This comprehensive 13-week curriculum bridges the gap between digital AI models and physical humanoid robots, teaching you how to design, simulate, and deploy embodied AI systems.

intro/overview.title: Overview of Physical AI Concepts
intro/overview.description: This section provides a high-level overview of the core concepts you'll explore throughout this book. Understanding these foundational ideas will help you navigate the complex landscape of embodied intelligence.

intro/setup.title: Environment Setup
intro/setup.description: Before diving into Physical AI concepts, you'll need to set up your development environment. This guide walks you through installing the necessary tools and verifying your setup.

syllabus.title: Course Syllabus: Physical AI & Humanoid Robotics

week-01/exercises.title: Week 1 Exercises: Exploring Embodied Intelligence
week-01/exercises.description: This week's exercises are designed to help you understand the fundamental concepts of embodied intelligence and apply them to practical scenarios. These exercises combine theoretical reflection with hands-on exploration.

week-01/index.title: Week 1: Introduction to Physical AI and Embodied Intelligence
week-01/index.description: Welcome to Week 1 of our Physical AI & Humanoid Robotics journey! This week, we'll establish the theoretical foundations of embodied intelligence and explore why the physical world presents unique challenges and opportunities for artificial intelligence.

week-01/theory-foundations.title: Theory Foundations: Embodied Intelligence
week-01/theory-foundations.description: This lesson delves deep into the theoretical foundations of embodied intelligence, examining the philosophical and mathematical underpinnings that distinguish Physical AI from traditional digital AI systems.

week-02/exercises.title: Week 2 Exercises: ROS 2 Fundamentals
week-02/exercises.description: This exercise sheet accompanies the Week 2 lessons on ROS 2 fundamentals. These exercises will help you practice and reinforce your understanding of nodes, topics, services, and actions in the context of Physical AI systems.

week-02/index.title: Week 2: ROS 2 Fundamentals - The Robotic Nervous System
week-02/index.description: Welcome to Week 2 of our Physical AI & Humanoid Robotics journey! This week, we'll dive deep into ROS 2 (Robot Operating System 2), the middleware that serves as the nervous system for modern robotics applications. ROS 2 provides the communication infrastructure, tools, and libraries essential for building complex robotic systems.

week-02/nodes-topics-services.title: Core ROS 2 Concepts: Nodes, Topics, Services, and Actions
week-02/nodes-topics-services.description: In this lesson, we'll dive deeper into the fundamental communication patterns in ROS 2. Understanding these concepts is crucial for building modular, scalable robotic systems that embody the principles of Physical AI.

week-02/ros2-fundamentals.title: ROS 2 Fundamentals: Practical Implementation Guide
week-02/ros2-fundamentals.description: This guide provides practical examples and implementation details for working with ROS 2 in Physical AI systems. We'll cover common patterns, best practices, and troubleshooting tips.

week-03/exercises.title: Week 3 Exercises: URDF Modeling and TF Transforms
week-03/exercises.description: This exercise sheet accompanies the Week 3 lessons on URDF modeling and TF transforms. These exercises will help you practice and reinforce your understanding of robot modeling and coordinate transformations in the context of Physical AI systems.

week-03/index.title: Week 3: Robot Modeling with URDF and Transformations
week-03/index.description: Welcome to Week 3! This week, we'll explore how to model robots in ROS 2 using URDF (Unified Robot Description Format) and understand the critical role of coordinate transformations in robotics. These concepts are fundamental for simulation, visualization, and control of robotic systems.

week-03/tf-transforms.title: Coordinate Transforms (TF) in Physical AI Systems
week-03/tf-transforms.description: In this lesson, we'll explore the Transform (TF) system in ROS, which is essential for understanding spatial relationships in Physical AI systems. TF allows us to track and transform data between different coordinate frames, which is crucial for perception, navigation, and manipulation tasks.

week-03/urdf-modeling.title: Week 3: Robot Modeling with URDF
week-03/urdf-modeling.description: Welcome to Week 3 of our Physical AI & Humanoid Robotics journey! This week, we'll explore URDF (Unified Robot Description Format), the standard for representing robot models in ROS. URDF is essential for defining the physical and visual properties of robots, which is fundamental for simulation, visualization, and control in Physical AI systems.

week-04/exercises.title: Week 4 Exercises: Simulation with Gazebo & Unity
week-04/exercises.description: This exercise sheet accompanies the Week 4 lessons on simulation environments for Physical AI systems. These exercises will help you practice and reinforce your understanding of Gazebo and Unity for creating digital twins.

week-04/gazebo-simulation.title: Week 4: Digital Twins with Gazebo & Unity
week-04/gazebo-simulation.description: Welcome to Week 4 of our Physical AI & Humanoid Robotics journey! This week, we'll explore simulation environments that serve as digital twins for physical robots. Simulation is a cornerstone of Physical AI development, allowing us to test algorithms safely, inexpensively, and repeatably before deploying on real hardware.

week-04/index.title: Week 4: Digital Twins with Gazebo & Unity
week-04/index.description: Welcome to Week 4! This week, we'll explore the creation of digital twins using Gazebo and Unity, learning how to build simulation environments that mirror real-world physics and robot behaviors. These simulation environments are critical for safe, cost-effective development and testing of robotic systems.

week-04/unity-integration.title: Unity Integration for Digital Twins in Physical AI
week-04/unity-integration.description: This lesson focuses on Unity as a platform for creating high-fidelity digital twins for Physical AI systems. Unity offers photorealistic rendering and advanced physics simulation capabilities that complement traditional robotics simulators like Gazebo.

week-05/exercises.title: Week 5 Exercises: NVIDIA Isaac and Perception Systems
week-05/exercises.description: This exercise sheet accompanies the Week 5 lessons on NVIDIA Isaac and perception systems. These exercises will help you practice and reinforce your understanding of GPU-accelerated perception in Physical AI systems.

week-05/index.title: Week 5: AI Robot Brain with NVIDIA Isaac
week-05/index.description: Welcome to Week 5! This week, we'll explore NVIDIA Isaac, a comprehensive robotics platform that provides GPU-accelerated simulation, perception, and manipulation capabilities. You'll learn how to leverage Isaac for building AI-powered robot brains that can perceive, reason, and act in complex environments.

week-05/isaac-sim-overview.title: Week 5: AI Robot Brain with NVIDIA Isaac
week-05/isaac-sim-overview.description: Welcome to Week 5 of our Physical AI & Humanoid Robotics journey! This week, we'll explore NVIDIA Isaac, a comprehensive platform for developing AI-powered robots. Isaac provides GPU-accelerated perception, navigation, and manipulation capabilities that are essential for modern Physical AI systems.

week-05/perception-systems.title: Perception Systems with NVIDIA Isaac
week-05/perception-systems.description: This lesson focuses on implementing perception systems using NVIDIA Isaac's GPU-accelerated capabilities. Perception is a critical component of Physical AI systems, enabling robots to understand their environment through sensors and AI algorithms.

week-06/exercises.title: Week 6 Exercises: SLAM and Navigation
week-06/exercises.description: This exercise sheet accompanies the Week 6 lessons on SLAM and navigation. These exercises will help you practice and reinforce your understanding of mapping, localization, and navigation in Physical AI systems.

week-06/index.title: Week 6: Navigation and Path Planning with SLAM
week-06/index.description: Welcome to Week 6! This week, we'll explore navigation and path planning systems for robots, including Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM). You'll learn how robots can navigate unknown environments, build maps, and plan safe paths to their destinations.

week-06/path-planning.title: Path Planning Algorithms for Physical AI Systems
week-06/path-planning.description: This lesson focuses on path planning algorithms that enable robots to navigate efficiently and safely in complex environments. Path planning is a critical component of Physical AI systems, bridging the gap between high-level goals and low-level motion control.

week-06/slam-navigation.title: Week 6: SLAM and Navigation with Nav2
week-06/slam-navigation.description: Welcome to Week 6 of our Physical AI & Humanoid Robotics journey! This week, we'll explore Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) and robot navigation using the Navigation2 (Nav2) framework. These technologies are fundamental for enabling robots to operate autonomously in unknown environments.

week-07/exercises.title: Week 7 Exercises: Vision-Language-Action Systems
week-07/exercises.description: This exercise sheet accompanies the Week 7 lessons on Vision-Language-Action (VLA) systems. These exercises will help you practice and reinforce your understanding of multimodal processing in Physical AI systems.

week-07/index.title: Week 7: Vision-Language-Action Robotics
week-07/index.description: Welcome to Week 7! This week, we'll explore Vision-Language-Action (VLA) robotics, which combines perception, reasoning, and action in embodied AI systems. You'll learn how to create robots that can understand natural language commands, perceive their environment visually, and execute appropriate actions.

week-07/multimodal-processing.title: Multimodal Processing in Vision-Language-Action Systems
week-07/multimodal-processing.description: This lesson focuses on the core challenge of multimodal processing in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) systems. Effective multimodal processing is essential for creating robots that can understand and act upon complex, real-world scenarios that require interpreting both visual and linguistic information simultaneously.

week-07/vla-introduction.title: Week 7: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) Robotics
week-07/vla-introduction.description: Welcome to Week 7 of our Physical AI & Humanoid Robotics journey! This week, we'll explore Vision-Language-Action (VLA) systems, which represent a significant advancement in embodied AI. VLA systems integrate visual perception, natural language understanding, and physical action, enabling robots to interpret complex human instructions and execute them in real-world environments.

week-08/balance-control.title: Balance Control Systems for Humanoid Robots
week-08/balance-control.description: This lesson focuses on the critical aspect of balance control in humanoid robots. Maintaining balance is one of the most challenging problems in humanoid robotics, requiring sophisticated control algorithms to manage the robot's center of mass and react to disturbances.

week-08/exercises.title: Week 8 Exercises: Humanoid Locomotion and Balance Control
week-08/exercises.description: This exercise sheet accompanies the Week 8 lessons on humanoid locomotion and balance control. These exercises will help you practice and reinforce your understanding of balance control and walking patterns in Physical AI systems.

week-08/humanoid-locomotion.title: Week 8: Humanoid Locomotion and Balance Control
week-08/humanoid-locomotion.description: Welcome to Week 8 of our Physical AI & Humanoid Robotics journey! This week, we'll explore the complex challenges of humanoid locomotion and balance control. Humanoid robots face unique challenges in maintaining stability while performing dynamic movements, making locomotion one of the most difficult problems in robotics.

week-08/index.title: Week 8: Humanoid Locomotion, Manipulation, and Interaction
week-08/index.description: Welcome to Week 8! This week, we'll explore humanoid robotics, focusing on the unique challenges of human-like locomotion, manipulation, and social interaction. You'll learn how to design and control robots that move, manipulate objects, and interact with humans in human-centered environments.

week-08/manipulation-interaction.title: Humanoid Manipulation and Social Interaction
week-08/manipulation-interaction.description: This lesson explores humanoid manipulation capabilities and social interaction systems. We'll cover dexterous manipulation with anthropomorphic hands, whole-body manipulation strategies, and social interaction protocols that enable natural human-robot collaboration.

week-09/exercises.title: Week 9 Exercises: Manipulation and Grasping
week-09/exercises.description: This exercise sheet accompanies the Week 9 lessons on manipulation and grasping. These exercises will help you practice and reinforce your understanding of robotic manipulation and grasp planning in Physical AI systems.

week-09/grasp-planning.title: Grasp Planning and Execution in Robotic Manipulation
week-09/grasp-planning.description: This lesson focuses on the critical aspect of grasp planning and execution in robotic manipulation. Grasp planning involves determining how to securely hold an object, which is fundamental for any manipulation task.

week-09/manipulation-basics.title: Week 9: Manipulation and Grasping
week-09/manipulation-basics.description: Welcome to Week 9 of our Physical AI & Humanoid Robotics journey! This week, we'll explore the fascinating world of robotic manipulation and grasping. Manipulation is a critical capability for humanoid robots, enabling them to interact with objects in their environment and perform complex tasks.

week-10/conversational-robots.title: Week 10: Conversational Robotics and Natural Language Interaction
week-10/conversational-robots.description: Welcome to Week 10 of our Physical AI & Humanoid Robotics journey! This week, we'll explore conversational robotics, which enables robots to interact with humans through natural language. This capability is essential for creating intuitive, accessible robotic systems that can collaborate effectively with humans.

week-10/exercises.title: Week 10 Exercises: Conversational Robotics
week-10/exercises.description: This exercise sheet accompanies the Week 10 lessons on conversational robotics. These exercises will help you practice and reinforce your understanding of natural language processing and human-robot interaction in Physical AI systems.

week-11/exercises.title: Week 11 Exercises: LLM-Based Planning and Cognitive Robotics
week-11/exercises.description: This exercise sheet accompanies the Week 11 lessons on LLM-based planning and cognitive robotics. These exercises will help you practice and reinforce your understanding of using large language models for high-level planning and reasoning in Physical AI systems.

week-11/llm-cognitive-planning.title: Week 11: LLM-Based Planning and Cognitive Robotics
week-11/llm-cognitive-planning.description: Welcome to Week 11 of our Physical AI & Humanoid Robotics journey! This week, we'll explore how Large Language Models (LLMs) can be used for high-level planning and cognitive reasoning in robotic systems. This represents a significant advancement in embodied AI, where robots can understand and execute complex, natural language instructions.

week-12/exercises.title: Week 12 Exercises: Sim-to-Real Transfer and Deployment
week-12/exercises.description: This exercise sheet accompanies the Week 12 lessons on sim-to-real transfer and deployment. These exercises will help you practice and reinforce your understanding of deploying robotic systems from simulation to real-world environments.

week-12/sim-to-real-deployment.title: Week 12: Sim-to-Real Transfer and Deployment
week-12/sim-to-real-deployment.description: Welcome to Week 12 of our Physical AI & Humanoid Robotics journey! This week, we'll explore the critical challenge of transferring systems from simulation to real-world deployment. This is one of the most important aspects of Physical AI, as the ultimate goal is to create robots that can operate effectively in the real world.

week-13/capstone-project.title: Week 13: Capstone Project - Physical AI & Humanoid Robotics Integration
week-13/capstone-project.description: Welcome to the final week of our Physical AI & Humanoid Robotics journey! This capstone project integrates all the concepts learned throughout the course into a comprehensive Physical AI system. You'll design, implement, and evaluate a complete robotic system that demonstrates the integration of perception, planning, control, and interaction capabilities.

week-13/exercises.title: Week 13 Exercises: Capstone Project - Physical AI & Humanoid Robotics Integration
week-13/exercises.description: This exercise sheet accompanies the Week 13 capstone project. This is the culmination of the entire course, where you'll integrate all the concepts learned into a comprehensive Physical AI system.
